title: b7z9.5.2: Node RX — reassembly of incoming SCHC fragments in Stack::receive
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.5. Wire AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver into Stack::receive(): fragment-kind L2 payloads (after L2 verify) feed the reassembler bounded by FragmentationPolicy (MAX_PEERS, expire_due hook on the receive loop), completed datagrams proceed into the existing SCHC decompress path; incomplete/expiring state dropped per spec. Landable before TX fragmentation exists (harmless capability); loopback-pair tests. Should land before b7z9.5.3 so peers can reassemble.
